title: VTC Boards — Delete — payload
description: A board manager deletes a closed board: its ideas, notes and each election's content are removed, and each election keeps only a tombstone for the community's tombstone retention. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the deletion in the community's audit trail.

Response.title: VTC Boards — Delete — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/delete/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/delete/0.1#response.

electionsRemoved.description: Elections whose content the community removed. Each keeps a tombstone unless the retention is zero.

tombstones.description: What the community keeps of the board's elections (VTI-BRD-007, VTI-BRD-008).

kept.description: Tombstones kept: each an election's identifier, manifest digest and the board heads the community kept. Zero when the retention is zero.

removeAt.description: When they are removed. Absent when the retention is unbounded, or when none was kept.
